brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build is piece:0,0,0;full alone at 0,0,0 level 0; no neighbors; counts piece:1 confirmed via get_build

Configurator offers no drawer sockets on a full hex base (find_sockets drawer total 0). Best case on a single isolated cell is a half base which offers 1 drawer socket (s167/s168) and quarters offer 0. Notch/bay drawers require adjacent bases and violate 'nothing else beside it'. Five drawers cannot be placed without breaking configurator rules.

finish.summary: Restored isolated single full hex base. Five drawers on one isolated cell is impossible in Hex Cluster: the configurator exposes 0 drawer sockets on a full base and max 1 on a half base; notch/bay drawers need neighboring cells.
